newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Senate confirms Cuomo to be HUD secretary.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Senate confirms Cuomo to be HUD secretary.

text.p: The Senate Wednesday confirmed Andrew Cuomo's nomination to be secretary of the Housing and Urban Development Department.
Cuomo, 39, has been an assistant HUD secretary for three years. He replaces Henry Cisneros.
The vote in favor of Cuomo was 99-0.
He is the third of Clinton's second-term cabinet nominees to be confirmed, joining Secretary of State Madeleine Albright and Defense Secretary William Cohen, who were approved last week.
Meanwhile, the Senate Commerce Committee approved William Daley's nomination to be secretary of the Commerce Department, clearing him for a vote by the full Senate.
